description: A three-stone family and a pave shank in one document: individual beads, no recess.
knownLimitations: PAVE_AWAITING_PROFESSIONAL_REVIEW: every pitch, bead radius, seat depth and stone scale in this field is a construction parameter. No pave dimension in JewelMind has been reviewed by a qualified jewelry professional, and this baseline records generated geometry rather than a manufacturing standard.
NO_RECESS: the host metal is not recessed for these stones.
SETTING_COVERAGE_PRIMARY_ONLY: the family's side stones have no metal holding them, unchanged from Sprint 24.
notes: Sprint 26 Pave & Microsetting Engine v1: INITIAL_BASELINE for a newly executable field. Created by running the real pipeline; no existing baseline was modified.
